purpose: Append two accepted prospective contract clarifications;do not rewrite the closed Phase A evidence
accepted_scope: numeric decision precedence,training-only candidate derivation and fixed ascending sidecar coordinates
unchanged_admission: SUBSUMED_PORTFOLIO;family-scoped,not literal CPV4 identity or measured ineffectiveness

prospective_precedence.condition: exactness failure OR oracle-route mean bytes >1014828776 OR p90 bytes of any executed route >1200000000
oracle-route mean bytes <=700000000 AND p90 bytes <=900000000
prospective_precedence.action: only this condition admits prospective moment-route evaluation after separate resource/execution registration

prospective_precedence.condition: capacity PASS;moment-route mean bytes <=750000000 AND p90 bytes <=900000000 AND mean bytes regret vs oracle <=1.15
prospective_precedence.action: no GO unless original prior-art,storage and exactness gates also pass

prospective_precedence.condition: capacity PASS;any router PASS condition fails,after excluding priority1 NO_GO conditions

prospective_precedence.action: stop;do not force a published final label or relax thresholds

candidate_derivation.input: Only the24 training query IDs of each frozen fold may supply parent nonhit per-coordinate mean squared contributions
candidate_derivation.block_score: Sum contributions over each of the30 fixed contiguous32-D blocks
candidate_derivation.prefix: Top4 blocks form a128-D coordinate subset;no extra learned/random/moment-derived subsets
candidate_derivation.candidate_identity: source qid;select four distinct source-qid candidates,not necessarily four unique coordinate subsets
candidate_derivation.duplicate_prefix_sets: retain;charge all four physical buffers and their update payload;no silent deduplication or K change
candidate_derivation.held_out_queries: not used for candidate generation,compiler objective,tuning or view selection during training
candidate_derivation.parent_derivation_is_new_execution: NOT_RUN;requires future registration and identity checks

sidecar_coordinate_order.approved_order: ascending original coordinate ID within each fixed materialized sidecar
sidecar_coordinate_order.query_order: only choose a view ID;do not produce an online dimension traversal order
sidecar_coordinate_order.CPU_bound_scope: same nonnegative rounded squared terms and sequential FP64 additions in original relative order under the preserved authority arithmetic;finite values and identical term generation remain required
sidecar_coordinate_order.exactness_qualification: NOT_RUN;complete raw fallback must bitwise match the original ordered-FP64 authority
sidecar_coordinate_order.GPU_reduction_scope: not qualified by this approval;warp/tree/reassociated reductions require a separately frozen numerical-safety contract

remaining_before_any_new_execution: new novelty/mechanism admission or an explicitly separate engineering-study scope
deterministic block-score ties/reduction arithmetic and complete input/source identities
p90 estimator and exact mean bytes-regret definition
metadata/moment maintenance,update visibility and complete cost scope
